summary: PrfHomeContacts is a user control for managing staff home contact details in a web application. It includes features for editing, saving, and validating contact information.
purpose: The purpose of PrfHomeContacts is to manage staff home contact information within the web application, allowing editing and validation of data through various controls and objects.

fields.name: ValidationSummary3
fields.description: A validation summary control for displaying validation messages.

fields.name: fvwEditHomeContacts
fields.description: A FormView control used for editing home contact details.

fields.name: dsStaff
fields.description: An ObjectDataSource control for staff data retrieval.

fields.name: UserSession
fields.description: HSPnet session information for the current user.

fields.name: ScreenIsEditable
fields.description: Indicates whether the screen is editable.

workflows.name: Edit Home Contacts
steps: Pre-render checks visibility of the save button based on edibility.
Removes phone masks if user session indicates.
Setup JavaScript variables for phone fields.
Data binding and item updating processes based on session details.

business_rules: Contact details are editable if 'ScreenIsEditable' is true.
validations: Phone fields are conditionally masked based on session settings.
Country field defaults to session country code if empty.
system_behavior: Disables edit fields if screen is not editable.
Uses AjaxControlToolkit for modal popups and validation summaries.
